About the role:
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE:  Drive category growth by leading in-store execution strategy through collaboration with Key Customer and commercial/trade team; ensuring category growth while Diageo’s brands are positioned to win at the point of sale through optimal assortment, shelving and education strategies.
This role also helps translate category growth drivers into actionable in-store recommendations, in collaboration with Channel & Category Development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Build objective and collaborative processes that allow us to create long term connections with key customers, including category growth drivers into Joint Business Plans.
- Position Diageo as the go-to and most trusted/respected partner for category management with key customers, by delivering best-in-class category management practices that include industry-leading insights, offered through impartial, compelling, and action-oriented recommendations.
- Develop and update In-store execution strategy aligned to category and shopper growth drivers
- Ensure alignment of assortment, merchandising, pricing, promotion, spirits section location, shelf layout and education mechanics based on shopper behavior and journey
- Lead planogram development and execution across Key customers and channels
- Deeply understand the shopper and their purchasing journey to educate and deliver a memorable shopping experience, enabling sustainable and profitable category growth.
- Influence & education agenda

DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Manage category data and develop insights to provide both internal and external consultancy
- Conduct assortment analysis and optimize the portfolio for each of the categories.
- Develop planograms (Spacesman), display guidelines and inclusion of new SKUs in the allocated category space.
- Create and present annual category growth plans for Key Customers, with monthly performance reviews using specialized Category Management tools and market performance analysis
- Monitor in-store performance (share of shelf, fair share, visibility KPIs) using store audits, sell-out data as well as data from dunnhumby and nielsenIQ to recommend corrective actions to sales teams based on performance gaps
- Work closely with Channel & Category Development, Shopper & Commercial Teams to translate category growth strategies into execution guidelines.

KEY RELATIONSHIPS FOR ROLE PERFORMANCE:
- Collaborations: Category & Channel Development, Sales, Shopper Marketing, Marketing, CP&A, Capabilities, and RGM.

ACHIEVEMENT OF BUSINESS KPIS:
- Spirits Growth in Key customers
- Increase category penetration, frequency or ticket based on Spirits opportunities
- Proper management of budgets assigned
- Timely deployment of plans in line with the planning process and milestone delivery
- Fair share of shelf across key customers
- Execution compliance rate vs. planogram
- Assortment quality and alignment with strategy
- Retailer satisfaction and trust (NPS/feedback)

PROFILE
- Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Industrial Engineering or related fields.
- Minimum of 6 years of experience in Category Management with key retailers in Colombia (Grupo Éxito, Olímpica, Oxxo, etc.); experience in other channels is a plus.
- Experience in Trade Marketing or sales with strong knowledge of execution pillars and point-of-sale strategy.
- Knowledge and management of sales performance indicators.
- Familiarity with tools such as SPACESMAN, Spacesplanning, Nielsen, and Dunnhumby.
- Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel.

CAPABILITIES & SKILLS REQUIRED
- Shopper Understanding: Deep knowledge of shopper missions and behavior at the point of purchase
- Analytical Thinking : Ability to analyze and synthesize EPOS, inventories, audit and Nielsen data into recommendations
- Executional Excellence : Strong operational mindset and focus on flawless in-store implementation
- Collaboration : Ability to work across commercial, customer, insights, and brand teams
- Influencing Skills : Able to influence both internal stakeholders and external retail partners
- Able to manage multiple projects simultaneously while effectively prioritizing tasks and adapting quickly to changing demands.

Sobre a Função:
Marketing é onde nossas marcas aparecem na cultura e permanecem lá.
É aqui que a criatividade encontra o insight. Pegamos um entendimento profundo de pessoas, cultura e tendências e transformamos isso em ideias que geram conversas e moldam como nossas marcas são vivenciadas ao redor do mundo.
Desde definir a estratégia da marca até lançar campanhas que as pessoas lembram, o trabalho aqui influencia como nos apresentamos nos momentos que importam.
Você fará parte de uma equipe curiosa, colaborativa e sempre olhando para frente, reinventando nossas marcas para o presente enquanto construimos o que vem a seguir.

Sobre o cargo:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para a posição de RTD Supply Chain Excellence Manager Senior, com atuação estratégica e transversal para revisar, estruturar e evoluir a cadeia de suprimentos da categoria RTD (Ready to Drink). Essa posição terá papel central na definição de um modelo operacional mais eficiente e escalável, conectando Supply, Vendas e Finanças para garantir a prontidão do negócio no curto, médio e longo prazo.
A função será responsável por avaliar, recomendar e implementar melhorias end-to-end nos processos de supply chain de RTD, considerando as particularidades da categoria em comparação com Spirits e assegurando maior agilidade, previsibilidade, produtividade e capacidade de resposta às variações de demanda.

Os 6 pilares principais da posição incluem:
- Sales Planning e Demand Alignment
Revisar a conexão entre demanda, forecast e planejamento, garantindo maior aderência às necessidades da categoria RTD.

- Customer Order Cycle e Process Design
Redesenhar o processo de pedidos para clientes-chave, reduzindo erros, simplificando fluxos e aumentando a eficiência operacional.

- Logistics e Distribution Model
Avaliar frequência de pedidos, janelas logísticas, modelo de atendimento e alternativas como Store vs. CD, buscando mais velocidade e melhor nível de serviço.

- Manufacturing, Warehouse e Production Readiness
Definir prioridades produtivas, janelas de produção e armazenagem para suportar o crescimento da categoria com consistência e escala.

- Procurement e Multi-sourcing Strategy
Estruturar modelos eficientes para contextos com sourcing múltiplo, incluindo operações in-house e TPO, com foco em custo, produtividade e continuidade.

- Cross-functional Governance e Financial Interface
Fortalecer a governança entre Supply, Vendas e Finanças, traduzindo decisões operacionais em impacto de negócio e assegurando alinhamento entre áreas.

Entre os desafios da posição estão também a definição de padrões para matéria-prima para portifolio completo de RTD e inovações, estratégia de estoque, padronização entre sites, revisão de políticas logísticas e construção de processos mais adequados a uma categoria com maior velocidade de giro e sensibilidade a ineficiências operacionais.

3. Sorumluluk alanı içerisinde yer alan distribütörlere doğru ve etkin ürün tedariği için Diageo Tedarik Zinciri birimiyle iş birliği yapmak; distribütörün satış servis kalitesini, verimlilik parametreleri ve diğer operasyonel performansının ölçümünü  ve raporlanmasını sağlamak.

4. Diageo tedarik zinciri ve Distribütör Saha Operasyon uzmanı ile koordineli calısarak VMI (otomatik stok yönetimi) süreclerine katkı saglamak; Pre-demand toplantılarına katılarak bölgesel iç görüleri paylaşmak; Diageo bölge satış müdürü ve müşteri hizmetleri ekibiyle birlikte S&OP (Satış ve Operasyon Planlama) süreclerini kurgulamak ve sonrasında sorumlu olduğu distribütör için bu süreci yönetmek.

Satış, markalarımızın gerçek dünyayla buluştuğu yerdir.
Bu ekip, ürünlerimizi hayata geçiren ilişkileri kurar ve geliştirir; markalarımızın anlam taşıyan anların bir parçası olmasını sağlamak için farklı pazarlar, kanallar ve tüketim fırsatları genelinde müşterilerle yakın iş birliği içinde çalışır.

1. Distribütör iş birliğini geliştirmek ve süreçlerin sistematik hale gelmesine katkı sağlamak; distribütör stoklarını doğru şekilde yönetmek.
5. Distribütör iş birliğini geliştirmek ve süreçlerin sistematik hale gelmesine katkı sağlamak.
6. Diageo Satış Strateji, Planlama ve Geliştirme gruplarına distribütör bölgesi hakkında doğru geri bildirimde bulunarak doğru hedefler ve doğru stratejiler oluşturulmasında katkıda bulunmak.
Distribütör iş birliğini geliştirmek ve süreçlerin sistematik hale gelmesine katkı sağlamak.
7. Distribütör iş birliğini geliştirmek ve süreçlerin sistematik hale gelmesine katkı sağlamak.

POSM dağılım ve uygulamalarının zamanında ve doğru yapılmasını sağlamak.

Job Description :
Job Title: Tax Reporting and Compliance Senior Analyst
Location: Budapest
Contract: permanent

About the role
This role sits in the Direct Tax Reporting and Compliance team, focusing on Rest of the World entities. It is critical in delivering the group tax external reporting requirements including our obligations under SOX.

This role is also focusing on ensuring that European, African, APAC markets’ direct tax processes (including Corporate income tax, suffered withholding tax and other supplementary returns) are undertaken accurately, efficiently (utilising automation and outsourcing where applicable) and on time and the surrounding internal control procedures, legislative requirements are strictly adhered to.

The scope for this role includes 2 major parts:
Direct tax reporting:
- including reporting and reconciliation of return to group report differences, maintaining and managing deferred tax schedules and reconciliation, filling OTP tax provision and deferred tax schedules for non-complex Diageo entities. (OTP- Diageo’s tax reporting system) Additional to the annual reporting, tasks include the Prior Year Adjustment (PYA) and P09 reporting processes for non-complex or medium-complex RoW reporting entities.

Direct tax compliance:
- activities such as corporate tax returns, GL reconciliation and supporting of the local tax manager based on the global agreement.

To perform quality reporting of the entities in scope for this role, both the external and internal reporting will need to be monitored by this role. It will be required to interpret the impact of the changes in the business, taxation and reporting environment to tax reporting.

There is a wide scope for exposure to key stakeholders within the Finance function. This role will need to effectively build up and manage relationship with GBO FC teams, with the compliance teams and local tax teams.

You will be responsible for
- Timely and accurate production of the group prior year tax adjustments and the P09 reporting for non-complex RoW entities in line with the IFRS standards and the group reporting instructions. Without material misstatements or auditor findings.
- Monitoring of changes to external environment with respect to reporting and taxation and assessment of impact to Diageo including understanding Group auditors’ position and managing to reach alignment on interpretations.
- Understanding the business changes and developments and proactively interpreting and managing the tax reporting implications of those, with special focus on allocated reporting entities.
- Compliance activities (including Corporate income tax, suffered withholding tax and other supplementary returns).

Experience / skills required
- Diploma on finance or accounting, 2-5 years of finance experience

- Interest and motivation to develop strong technical accounting skills with an excellent understanding of IFRS

- Good communication and influencing skills that facilitate effective networking and relationship building with senior stakeholders

- Ability to work to deadlines and under pressure

- Good judgement

- Imaginative thinker of capable of devising solutions to complex issues
-
- Self-motivated and well organised approach to work
